SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2896
ate 11. 11. 31.

Shanghai November 10, 1931.

Concession Francaise de Shanghai.
Police Department.
Political Section.

No 16/S.P.

My dear Givens,

I have conveyed to Mr. Fiori the complaints
of the British Authorities regarding the police of the Rue
du Chu-Pao-San.

Mr. Fiori, in co-operation with the French
Naval and Military Authorities, has issued orders to increase
the number of Foreign members of the police in the Rue du
Chu-Pao-San, especially on the paydays.

General Fleming is personally satisfied with
the measures taken.

Yours cordially
(Signed) Sarly.

T.P. Givens Esq.,
A/C Commissioner of Police.

（批：R.M.）
Commissioner of Police,

1931年11月10日，上海。

上海法租界。
警务处。
政治科。

编号 16/S.P.

亲爱的吉文斯（Givens）：

我已向菲奥里先生（Mr. Fiori）转达了英国当局关于朱葆三路（Rue du Chu-Pao-San）警务问题的投诉。

菲奥里先生在与法国海军及军事当局协商后，已下令增加朱葆三路的外籍警员人数，特别是在发薪日。

弗莱明将军（General Fleming）对已采取的措施 personally 表示满意。

此致
敬礼
（签名）萨利（Sarly）

T.P. 吉文斯（Givens）先生，
代理警务总监。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2876
Date 9 11 31.

November 9, 1.

My dear Sarly,

With reference to our conversation on Saturday,
I have to state that, according to reports received by
the Municipal Police from the British Military Authorities,
there were large numbers of British sailors from H.M.S.
"Suffolk" and large numbers of French sailors from the
Cruiser "Waldeck Rousseau" ashore in the cabarets on Rue
Chu Pao San on November 3rd, 1931. It is said that the
bulk of the men were under the influence of drink, and
that considerable antagonism manifested itself between those
of British and French nationality. It is said that the
hostility almost resulted in fights on several occasions,
and that the French Naval Picquet present was inadequate
to deal with the unruly element among their nationals.

I should deem it a favour if you would kindly let
me know by telephone later what you have done about this
matter.

Yours sincerely,

Monsieur R. Sarly,
Section Politique, Services de
Police, Municipalite Francaise.

Sent out
9/11 N.P.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处
编号：S. B. D. 2876
日期：31年11月9日

11月9日，1。

亲爱的萨利（Sarly）：

关于我们星期六的谈话，兹陈述如下：根据工部局警务处从英国军事当局收到的报告，1931年11月3日，来自英国皇家海军“萨福克”号（H.M.S. "Suffolk"）的大量英国水兵和来自巡洋舰“瓦尔德克-卢梭”号（"Waldeck Rousseau"）的大量法国水兵上岸，出现在朱葆三路（Rue Chu Pao San）的各歌舞厅中。据说大部分人都处于醉酒状态，英法两国籍人员之间表现出相当大的敌意。据说这种敌意几次几乎引发斗殴，而当时在场的法国海军纠察队不足以应对其本国国民中的不法之徒。

如蒙您稍后通过电话告知我对此事采取了何种措施，我将不胜感激。

此致
敬礼，

R. 萨利（Sarly）先生，
法租界公董局警务处政治科。

发出
11月9日 N.P.

pages.en:
Subject:- Provocative and disorderly conduct of ratings from the
French Cruiser "WALDECK ROUSSEAU".
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

REPORT

To:- The D.A.P.M.,
Shanghai Area.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
（印：PROVOST MARSHAL'S OFFICE China Command）

Sir,

I have to report for your information, that at Shanghai,

on the 3rd November, 1931, I was N .C.O. Visiting Night Duties,
and in consequence of the disorderly conduct in general of the
men of the French Cruiser "WALDECK ROUSSEAU" I was compelled to
confine most of my time to Rue Privee Chu Pao San (French
Concession.

There were a large number of ratings and marines from the
Cruiser "H.M.S. Suffolk" and the French Cruiser "WALDECK ROUSSEAU"
in the Cabarets up till midnight, and I had to assist the Naval
Patrol to prevent three fights in three separate Cabarets, two
of which I actually saw started between French and British
sailors and the Frenchmen had purposely provoked the British
sailors.

Their general conduct was disgraceful, approximately 80
per cent being drunk and pulling and dragging each other along,
and purposely knocking other sailors off the pathway.

The French Naval Picquet on duty - six men and a "sous-
officier" appeared to be impotent, the French sailors absolutely
disregarding any feeble attempt at interference on their part.

I render this report in order that something is done
before anything very serious occurs between the two factions.

Shanghai,
4-11-1931.

（手写批注：Forward to D.A.P.M. / [签名] / 7/11）

（签名）
Sergt.,
Military Foot Police
pages.zh:
事由：法国巡洋舰“瓦尔德克-卢梭”号（WALDECK ROUSSEAU）水兵的挑衅及扰乱秩序行为。
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

报告

致：上海地区助理副军法长（D.A.P.M.），
上海地区。
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
（印章：中国司令部 军法处长办公室）

阁下：

兹向您报告，以供阅知，在上海，

1931年11月3日，我担任夜间值班士官，由于法国巡洋舰“瓦尔德克-卢梭”号（WALDECK ROUSSEAU）水兵普遍存在扰乱秩序的行为，我不得不将大部分时间花在朱葆私路（Rue Privee Chu Pao San）（法租界）。

直到午夜，来自英国皇家海军“萨福克”号巡洋舰（H.M.S. Suffolk）和法国“瓦尔德克-卢梭”号巡洋舰（WALDECK ROUSSEAU）的大量水兵和陆战队员聚集在歌舞厅内，我不得不协助海军巡逻队阻止了三起发生在三家不同歌舞厅的斗殴事件，其中两起我亲眼目睹是由法国水兵故意挑衅英国水兵而引发的。

他们的总体行为令人羞耻，约80%的人喝醉了，互相拉扯拖拽，并故意将其他水兵撞离人行道。

值班的法国海军纠察队——由六名士兵和一名“下级军官”（sous-officier）组成——似乎无能为力，法国水兵完全无视他们微弱的干预企图。

我提交此报告，以便在两派势力发生任何非常严重的事件之前采取相应措施。

上海，
1931年11月4日。

（手写批注：转交助理副军法长 / [签名] / 11月7日）

（签名）
中士，
军事步警
